purpose: S2 protocol, written before the fix.

sampler_declaration.model: independent-stream approximation with a public-history-derived candidate set
sampler_declaration.not_claimed: the exact posterior of the original game's correlated seeded streams
sampler_declaration.rule: the true hidden value may never be a prior, a filter, or a sampling seed; when public history determines the value it is kept, otherwise a candidate is drawn once per simulation
sampler_declaration.versioning: intent/observation semantics bump schema+encoding; sampler algorithm bumps sampler revision
